acceptance.f1722_five_hole_causal_pilot: Abaqus 2023 single-rank serial solve executes causal-isolation pilot to uy = 0.00580 mm; advancement past uy = 0.0056645 mm without cutback exhaustion supports hypothesis F1721-H1-R1 (committed-state staggered operator-split coupling improves continuation in the tested configuration); repeated stalling at uy = 0.0056645 mm indicates modification alone was insufficient in this configuration; reaction force equilibrium verified via bottom-boundary summation and damage bounds d in [0, 1] verified via UMAT overlay STATEV (SDV1).
